text:
maria: Quick sync — post-prod week 1. Need to decide which issues go into the 3-day "sequel" sprint. Shortlist: 8 customer-impact bugs, 12 UX enhancements, 3 regressions. Proposal: critical bugs + regressions in; other customer-impact items pick top revenue ones; small enhancements as quick wins (<=1d). Will assemble triage list by 16:00. Thoughts?

ajay: SG. +1 on critical/regression rule. Need clearer def for "customer-impact" vs "annoyance".

kelly: Proposal: customer-impact = (1) report from paying customer OR (2) >=5 reports in prod in last 72h OR (3) causes feature failure. Annoyance = cosmetic or perf degradation <20% with workaround. Also call out security/PII as always urgent.

sam: Agreed. I'll run the queries and drop the shortlist here.

triage-bot: query run: `label:customer-impact status:open priority:high` -> 8 results. Top ids: #3421, #3478, #3502. Full list in the ticket board.

sam: Pasting quick grep of hits:
```
#3421 — payment flow timeout (3 reports, paying customers)
#3478 — autocomplete returns stale suggestions (8 reports, enterprise)
#3502 — chat history missing after reload (5 reports)
```

jordan: For enhancements, can we reserve one engineer for quick wins (<=1d) so we clear obvious UX friction?

maria: Yes — allocate ~40% dev capacity for quick wins (up to 5 items). Rest prioritized by impact/effort. Decision rules:
- critical/regression => IN for sequel sprint
- customer-impact non-blocking => top 4 by revenue impact => IN
- enhancements <=1d => pick up to 5 as quick wins => IN
- everything else => backlog groom for next major cycle

ajay: :thumbsup: ack. I'll tag revenue-impact on the tickets and rank.

kelly: :white_check_mark: ack. Will move selected enhancements to milestone `sprint-sequel-1` and add acceptance criteria.

sam: I'll assign owners and update the tickets with target milestone (`sprint-sequel-1`). Also will add test steps for the regressions.

maria: Timeline: confirm final list here by 16:00. After that we'll update tickets and set pipeline checkpoints: staging smoke by Tue, canary Wed, full rollout Fri. Any blockers?

ajay: None on my side. I'll coordinate with sales for any required customer comms.

kelly: None. Will finalize ACs and short descriptions.

deploy-bot: FYI — tentative canary window requested: Fri 18:00. Please flag if that conflicts.

maria: Thanks all. Final list expected at 16:00; I'll post summary + owners then. If anyone wants to push an item, add a comment on the ticket with impact and effort estimate before 15:00.

jordan: Noted. Will surface one more enhancement candidate by 14:30.

maria: Great — see you in the final check. :rocket:
